content: Bepaŋdi nemenemek hogohogok yehitubu-mintaguk doktiŋa wou nintilonim
Welenedi Yahwe niutumbawit! Yahwe, du Bepaŋne, du adi loloŋnit hinek. Tiŋa du adi Mapme loloŋnit hinek eŋ wohogigitnit.
Du adi hautadi folooge mukufuladapmaaŋ hataŋ. Tiŋa kunum adi haule yehitubu-bateyeyam nabugoŋ tububateyeune hatak.
Tiŋa yoke adi mulukwaŋ yalakapmeeŋ foloniŋ gimiŋgimiŋ hinek gwaŋ maguŋ. Eŋ mulukwaŋdi kalisge kali wilihinit wosidi yehimaneiŋ undiniŋ nabugoŋ tilak. Kaŋ sububadi ganagila yaulak.
Du sububa niŋkulune medege tiŋa yaulak. Kaŋ filimpit tiŋa hauta tilak woŋ adi kwanai-mege.
Du kwet i kwelineŋ dibek kameguŋ undugoŋ fafaŋeŋ hatak, adi kweli bikabu-kabe nemu tilak. Mokoŋ hinek.
Du imeŋgwaŋ wapum kameune kwet kufulaguk, kaŋ imedi kweboboe yehikufulaguk.
Iŋgoŋ mindaŋ ime nintobune naŋgali foguk. Tiŋa undugoŋ gibitaŋ kutifiyeune imeŋgwaŋdi nadihakene momoŋ uguk.
Imeŋgwaŋ wapum adi kweboboe bikabuŋa kwet gutuneŋ foguk. Da imeŋgwaŋdi daŋ halaak nadiguŋ wondok tuwot undugoŋ hatak.
Da fek kamemiŋguŋ. Kaŋ imeŋgwaŋ wapum u fek mu lahutak. Wendoktiŋa imeŋgwaŋdi kwet i kotigoŋ mu kufulalak.
Dagoŋ nadilaŋ kaŋ kweboboe yaliwiiŋ lekiŋgoŋhik foloŋ kubali gineŋ ime sikiiŋ, sila labuŋa wodiŋa wooŋ kwet gutuneŋ wiiŋ.
Kale moihi adi ime uŋakoŋ naiŋ, eŋ doŋki heki adi maaŋ ime uŋakoŋ naiŋ, kaŋ mahik kotigoŋ mu galilak.
Eŋ bagi hekidi maaŋ yohik bem ime gagayeŋ yakiiŋ wendok foloŋgoŋ maiŋ, tiŋa bem taŋeniŋ foloŋ ila medehik toiŋ.
Du kunum gineŋ hali gwi kameune fooŋ kweboboe foloŋ malak, kaŋ du’walaŋ kahaŋgedi kwet wapum i tokidapmalak.
Dagoŋ nadilaŋ kaŋ kilihikit labiiŋ kaŋ makau hekidi naiŋ, eŋ nemenemek metam indi diniyetiyam u maaŋ nadilaŋ kaŋ looŋ folooŋ mintaiŋ kaŋ behenaŋ tiyam.
Eŋ wain tutumbaaŋ naaŋ nadifo tiyam, tiŋa bem olif meniŋŋiŋ galikit u namandatnik foloŋ hafiyeeŋ waliniŋ diweyaam. Eŋ nanaŋe nakilitiŋa saŋiniŋhinit tiyam.
Gwi maune bem Lebanon uŋoŋ yakiiŋ adi kokoihikdi ime kedem hinek hamaneiŋ. Bem sida heki adi Yahwe ne’walaŋ hinek, u koom negoŋ yetiguk.
Bagi heki adi bem sida foloŋ yohik uŋgoŋ maiŋ. Eŋ kowaŋ heki adi kwele foloŋ yohik maiŋ.
Kaŋ meme moihi adi kweboboe foloŋ hatiiŋ, eŋ daumeŋ heki adi kawade mage ginaneŋ hebihakiiŋ.
Du muyakip kameguŋ kaŋ adi gulet indigoŋ tuwot muyakip nai yobihitak, eŋ mele adi nai deniŋ tebeledaune fohebidok u agaŋ nadilak.
Dagoŋ nadiguŋ kaŋ mambip mintaguk, unduŋ doktiŋa mambip tilak kaŋ kale moihi hogohogok adi tali yawiiŋ.
Kaŋ laion pamala adi kale du yemilaŋ u yehisiŋa nanaŋdok mahaŋ gibita toŋa yawiiŋ.
Ala mele labulak kaŋ kotigoŋ momoŋ wooŋ kawade mage gineŋ foiŋ.
Kaŋ metamdibo pilali wooŋ kwanaihik tihatibune wooŋ bufalak.

Yahwe, du yadi nemenemek fee hinek tutumbaguŋ. Du adi nadinadige loloŋnit hinek doktiŋa nemenemek hogohogok i tutumbaguŋ. Kaŋ nemenemek hogohogok kwetfoloŋ iŋoŋ kilidapmaaŋ hatak u da yobune mintadapmaguk.
Imeŋgwaŋ adi wapum kakaŋ hinek, kaŋ pisi wapuhi eŋ kuyahi tiŋa nemek noli maaneŋ hakiiŋ, u indi kunadapmanimdok tuwot mokoŋ.
Kaŋ muwage wapuhi adi imeŋgwaŋtabe uŋgoŋ woŋambuŋat tiiŋ, eŋ pisi wapuhi yapmeguŋ adi maaŋ ime gineŋ yauŋila tatakut tatakut tiyawiiŋ.
Nemenemek hogohogok adi map tiŋa du nanaŋe nai foloŋgoŋ yembeŋ yoŋa woom hatiiŋ.
Kaŋ dagoŋ nanaŋe yemilaŋ kaŋ natoki tiiŋ.
Ala du sigilulum tiyemilaŋ kaŋ adi munta tiiŋ, eŋ munabuthik yolom tilaŋ kaŋ adi kumuŋa kotigoŋ kwet yageleiŋ.
Dagoŋ munabut fedidahiyembune adi kaipmuŋ hatiiŋ. Tiŋa undugoŋ dagoŋ nadilaŋ kaŋ nemenemek gitipmuhi kwetfoloŋ iŋoŋ mintaaŋ labiiŋ.
Yahwe’walaŋ wougigitŋiŋ adi dapmandapmaŋnit mokit hatuwaak. Eŋ Yahwe ne adi nemenemek hogohogok tutumbaguk wendok nadifo tibek.
Adi kwet kaune kwet adi tibitim tilak, eŋ kohoŋdi kweboboe wehemilune kweboboe foloŋ mupmuk labulak.
Nu kaipmuŋ hatiŋa Yahwedok kap fee tomiluwaat. Nu mu kumuŋa kaipmuŋ hatiŋila Bepaŋne wou nintilooŋ kap heki tomiŋa hatigene kumumbene dapmawaak.
Negoŋ nadifo tubumintanamulak, unduŋ doktiŋa nu’walaŋ nadituwatuwale i kedem nadiŋa nadigalika tibek.
Yahwe, du metam kadakaniŋ titiŋ heki hogohogok u kedem yehitubu-kadakaweŋ. Nu adi me hogohi u liwehinaka tineŋdok nadilat. Welenedi Yahwe niutumbawit! Yahwe niutumbaneŋ!
